profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm a full-stack engineer with 5+ years of experience building and scaling production systems that process over a million transactions monthly. I specialize in turning complex, legacy architectures into clean, maintainable platforms — and in leading cross-functional teams to ship features that move the needle on real business outcomes.  

My core stack spans React, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS, Python, PostgreSQL, and Docker. I'm comfortable owning the full vertical slice — from database schema and REST API design to custom React hooks and polished ShadCN interfaces.  I've led architecture decisions that reduced service footprints, improved load times by 58%, and helped raise $2.7M in enterprise funding through production-grade credential verification systems.  What sets me apart is the combination of technical depth and product thinking.  

As an engineer at Unicity International, I don't just write code — I run sprint planning, groom tickets, collaborate with product and design, and make sure the team's work maps to real business requirements. I've built real-time trading visualizations that improved user conversion by 33%, modernized payment processing pipelines, and delivered end-to-end features across fintech, healthcare, and DeFi domains.  

I thrive in environments where engineering quality and product impact go hand in hand.  Whether I'm untangling a legacy stored procedure, designing a new API contract, or mentoring engineers through a tough architectural decision, I bring clarity, ownership, and a bias toward shipping.
